name: Cinolazepam
summary: Cinolazepam is a short-acting benzodiazepine sleep medicine used for short-term treatment of insomnia, mainly when falling asleep is the problem.
description: Cinolazepam is a short-acting benzodiazepine with a strong calming, sleep-inducing effect. It is used mainly for short-term treatment of insomnia, especially when the main problem is falling asleep. It starts working quickly and does not stay in your body very long, so it tends to cause less next-day drowsiness than longer-acting benzodiazepines. It is not approved in the United States and is available in some European countries.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Cinolazepam is a short-acting benzodiazepine with strong sedative and hypnotic properties. It is indicated mainly for the short-term treatment of insomnia, particularly when difficulty initiating sleep is the main complaint. Due to its pharmacokinetic profile, cinolazepam has a rapid onset of action and a relatively short elimination half-life, reducing next-day residual sedation compared to longer-acting benzodiazepines. It is not approved in the United States and is available in select European markets.
